_comment: invent.c addinv_core2() and learn_unseen_invent(), polyself.c newman(). Variation on archeologist-unblind-deciphers-before-split, with the same game start: the Archeologist is blind because she has polymorphed into an eyeless small mimic, not because of a blindfold. She wishes for two scrolls while eyeless, then polymorphs back into a human; newman() restores her sight through toggle_blindness(), which deciphers the scrolls ("You can see again." then "You decipher the label on your scrolls labeled ...") before she wields one of them with a count.
